link_vapi_call returns {linked:true} if the vapi_call_id exists on ANY session, even another lead's. Nothing is overwritten, but response is misleading; scope the existence check to lead_id.

Without lead_token in variableValues it falls back to the most recent real walkthru_initiated lead, so a status-update/tool call could link a call id onto another homeowner's open session. Consider skipping linking when lead was resolved via fallback.

ended_at = history[2].at + 6 min, but history[2] is ~4 min ago, so Maya's ended_at is ~2 min in the future right after seeding (observed started 13:33:41, ended 13:39:41, now 13:38:04). Base it on started_at earlier in the past.
